review.reason: The change adds bounded capability and correctness improvements: it introduces caching and conditional loading of Action data while preserving existing functionality. The implementation and relevant checks are visible, including guards against duplicate loads and removals from callers. This does not reach tier 3 because no broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency restructuring is demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Action-related filtering and editing workflows benefit from reduced redundant API calls and clearer loading states. Shared insights and cohort filters avoid unnecessary network traffic when they cannot use actions.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on frontend-only evidence; lack of backend or migration context prevents full confidence. No adoption or incident avoidance can be inferred.
